title: 一次操作超时后同一按钮永远无法重试

history.evidence: Diff swaps timeout and rate-limit composition so a timeout rejection unwinds the in-flight finally. Historical order restored; production wrappers unchanged.

problem_zh: 生成界面的一项操作超时后，用户等过冷却时间再重试仍一直被限流。只有重建该界面才恢复。请修复操作包装链的生命周期，确保超时后能恢复重试、冷却窗口仍有效，正常完成与迟到失败不会破坏后续操作。
test_scope: Imports production action composition, timeout, cooldown and telemetry modules; fake timers control completion order.
